sequence_source: A-beta 42 peptide sequence (42 aa) from the APP amyloid-beta region
coordinate_system: Region start/end are 0-based, half-open sequence slices [start,end).

salt_bridge.note: D23-K28 in 1-based numbering; effect is context dependent, see mechanism

_action_space: (i, j, strength): contact-selective energy modulation on pair (i,j), followed by ordinary Metropolis relaxation. NOT a mechanical force.
_note: Public profile. The verifier uses a separate hidden profile with shifted conditions and a hidden mechanism.

_polar_zipper.shared: Same constants in every task. The effect differs only because Q content differs - the mechanism is universal, not per-task tuning.
_polar_zipper.label: [B] biologically motivated; functional form mirrors the saturable directional backbone term

normalised.elastic_limit: 20.13 = p90 of the no-op E_bond+E_angle distribution under the current chemistry. Rule: charge irreversible damage only for geometry beyond the 90th percentile of the UNCONTROLLED working range. This reproduces the original Abeta42 value (20.0 vs p90 20.13); the '1.418x median' multiple used earlier was a post-hoc description, not the rule.

_mechanism_v9.change: beta_ladder() now requires the rung's attractive interaction to be present: a pair whose modulation exceeds ladder_mod_block is not counted as a ladder rung.
_mechanism_v9.why: In v8.0 the action modulated energy while the pathology order parameter read pure geometry, with no working causal link. Measured on the public validation split: suppressing the entire ladder at full strength every step with no decay moved pathology by at most -0.04 vs no-op, and under the shipped physics by +0.045 (worse). Widening action reach made it worse (+0.5708 -> +0.5805).
_mechanism_v9.rule: Fixed by rule before measurement: a rung counts as blocked once its attractive interaction is suppressed by more than half. Not fitted to any outcome.
_mechanism_v9.consequence: With mod_gain=0.85 and mod_decay=0.8 one action holds a rung blocked for ~3 steps, so roughly 3 of ~7 rungs can be held at once. Which rungs, and when, becomes the control problem; the nucleus term (weight 0.4) makes the rung that splits the longest run the high-value target.

_pathology_v9.revision: post-A3 design revision, made after A3 failed and disclosed as such
_pathology_v9.before: path = path_inter*inter + path_intra*intra + path_nucleus*(n_run-L_min+1) + path_locked*locked_core; driven by the length of the single longest run, so shortening it anywhere paid the same
_pathology_v9.after: path = path_nucleus * sum over CRITICAL runs of (len-L_min+1)^path_exp / path_norm + path_locked * locked_in_critical
_pathology_v9.convexity: path_exp=2.0 makes splitting a run mid-way worth ~7x trimming its end for an 8-rung run, while the two rungs look identical edge by edge
_pathology_v9.decoys: a run is critical only once its mean contact age reaches path_crit_age; younger runs are ladder-positive, observationally identical and worth nothing, but still cost budget and can cost damage
_pathology_v9.dynamic: disrupting a nucleus resets its age and promotes whichever rival nucleus grew unattended, so the critical target moves during the episode
_pathology_v9.path_crit_age_rule: tau_mat / 4 = 8: pathologically relevant once persisted a quarter of the time needed to lock. Rule, not a fit.
_pathology_v9.path_norm_rule: chosen so the no-op trajectory reproduces the mean final pathology of the previous definition, so path_thresh and the damage coupling keep their meaning

path_norm_measured.rule: path_norm anchors the uncontrolled trajectory at the damage threshold: the no-op mean final pathology equals path_thresh, so doing nothing is exactly marginal.
path_norm_measured.superseded_rule: The first rule — reproduce the previous definition's no-op mean of 1.609 — is INFEASIBLE and was abandoned. Pathology feeds damage, damage shortens episodes, and shorter episodes suppress pathology, so raising path_norm lengthens episodes and regenerates what it removed. The no-op mean floors near 2.1 while path_norm runs away past 123.

_pathology_v9_1.revision: v9.1 relational composition, made after A3 failed a second time
_pathology_v9_1.removed_from_observation: the per-edge `ladder` membership flag (EDGE_DIM 12 -> 11). It announced exactly what pathology counted, which is why a 3-parameter readout of that single flag reached 95% of the full policy's gain.
_pathology_v9_1.criticality: a nucleus is critical when it spans at least path_L_crit=3 contiguous rungs AND its mean contact age reaches path_crit_age. Age alone no longer identifies a target: an old two-rung run is a decoy, contact-for-contact indistinguishable from a rung of a real nucleus.
_pathology_v9_1.L_crit_rule: a productive amyloid seed spans at least three contiguous rungs; shorter contacts are transient. Fixed by rule before measurement.
_pathology_v9_1.bridges: a ladder contact joining two DIFFERENT critical nuclei welds them into one assembly. Bridges carry no weight of their own — they act through the existing convexity, so two 4-rung nuclei welded by one bridge score (9-L_min+1)^2 = 64 instead of 2*(4-L_min+1)^2 = 18. Cutting the bridge is worth far more than cutting an isolated contact, and the two are locally identical.
_pathology_v9_1.why_not_a_separate_weight: a bridge weight would be one more scalar for a per-edge readout to fit. Routing bridges through convexity means their value depends on the sizes of the two assemblies they join, which is not a property of the contact.

n_chains.why: With two chains the system is too small for cluster topology: bridges between distinct critical nuclei fired in 0.5% of snapshots under a ladder-pair definition and 6.4% under the widest sensible contact-based one, even though two or more critical nuclei coexisted in 35% of snapshots. A mechanism that fires in 6% of steps cannot carry a decision the benchmark is built on.
n_chains.seeding: The nucleation seed still registers chains 0 and 1. Chains beyond the pair start close enough to associate but are NOT pre-registered, so a second nucleus has to grow, and it can be welded to the first through the middle chain.
